bullets.text: Full-year CR 90.6; PL CR 90.3; CL CR 86.7; Property CR 106.9, heavily affected by catastrophes; Gainshare score reached 1.91, the highest mark since 2004.
Companywide NPW +20% YOY to surpass $30B, adding over $5B in 2018; Personal Lines NPW +18%; Commercial Lines NPW grew nearly 30%; Property NPW increased 33%.
Total PIF surpassed 20M; auto PIF grew over 14% past 13M, adding the latest 1M in six months; Robinsons customer count topped 1M; over 2M customers retained 10+ years.

Adopted new dividend policy expecting $0.10 quarterly dividend through 2019 plus potential annual variable payout; declared $2.514/share 2018 dividend; issued $1.15B senior notes and $500M preferred stock; portfolio return 1.2%.
Expense ratio reached 20.4%; PL NAER declined 0.7 pts to 9.1%; CL NAER fell 0.8 pts to 11.0%; LAE ratio decreased 0.7 pts to 10.2%, aided by lower claim feature settlement costs.

Retained catastrophe losses and LAE reached $295M from hurricanes, hail, winter storms, and California wildfires, adding 23 pts to Property CR; reinsurance limited retained Hurricane Michael losses and LAE to $60M.

Three Horizons framework guides growth: Horizon 1 executes core auto and home; Horizon 2 expands adjacencies including BOP and Uber; Horizon 3 explores future opportunities led by new Chief Strategy Officer.

Completed new policy processing system for auto and special lines; launched 'Ask Flo' mobile virtual assistant, AI customer inquiry chatbot, Docuflash OCR document routing, and natural-voice IVR system.
Launched FAO Portfolio quoting platform in three states to enable multi-product bundled quotes across auto, special lines, and property, with full countrywide agency rollout expected by mid-2020.

Expanded advertising spend to over $1.4B with in-house media optimization; introduced Flo’s Squad creative campaign; doubled auto and home bundle media impressions compared to 2015; delivered HQX and BQX shopping experiences.
